resources.string: Shorten the region to at most 16,384 characters (some symbols count as two), or clear it to leave it unanswered.
Use exactly three uppercase letters (A-Z), or clear this field to leave it unanswered.
Use a nonnegative number without leading zeros, optionally followed by a decimal point and 1 to 12 digits. Leave blank for unanswered. Limit: 16,384 characters.
Use a whole number of requests per day, 0 or greater, with no leading zeros and at most 128 digits. Leave blank for unanswered.
Use a whole number of average input tokens, 0 or greater, with no leading zeros and at most 128 digits. Leave blank for unanswered.
Use a whole number of average output tokens, 0 or greater, with no leading zeros and at most 128 digits. Leave blank for unanswered.
Use a whole concurrency count of at least 1, with no leading zeros and at most 128 digits. Leave blank for unanswered.
Use a whole number of milliseconds, at least 1, with no leading zeros and at most 128 digits. Leave blank for unanswered.
